note: Missing `audience`. A presentation bound to no verifier can be replayed to any of them.
Missing `nonce`. Without it a verifier cannot tell this presentation from one captured earlier.
Empty `claims`. An empty disclosure set authorises nothing, and must not read as 'everything'.
Whitespace in `audience`. An audience is one identifier, never a list.
Unknown top-level member — `holder` is never chosen by the consumer; it is the credential's own subject.
